title: Causal two-state Hidden Markov filter

paper.title: A New Approach to the Economic Analysis of Nonstationary Time Series and the Business Cycle

hypothesis: Forward-filtered state probabilities can describe regime uncertainty without using full-path hindsight labels.
causalBoundary: At t the posterior uses the frozen transition and emission parameters plus observations through t only; Viterbi backtracking is excluded.
counterfactual: Swapping frozen emission means should swap state interpretation without improving predictive evidence on unseen observations.
